topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Oh man, I just found out someone inked my artwork onto their skin! Can you even believe it? I was scrolling through my feed, minding my own business, when I stumbled upon this photo. The colors, the lines—it's unmistakably my piece. I’m just floored. I mean, yeah, it’s flattering and all, to think that someone loves my work enough to make it a part of them forever. But wow, I guess I never really expected it to go this far. I’ve got to reach out to them, see if they’re okay with me sharing it, maybe even post it myself. What do you think? Should I slide into their DMs or just let it be?
